resources.string: "Skill already runs automatically with Translate. This manual review/correction screen is optional; it is not needed to finish translation."

"1. Read the original and the neighbouring dialogue.
2. Preserve negation, conditions and who does what to whom.
3. Check numbers, ratios and % within the same block.
4. Keep your preferred story names; do not translate a name’s dictionary meaning.
5. Use natural dialogue without inventing speakers or story facts.
6. Choose Uncertain if context is insufficient.
7. Inspect erasure, placement and joined letters in the page editor.

These are local checks and corrections, not Claude or an automatic meaning score. Translation keeps using your selected online/offline mode."
"Hints are not meaning scores. “Checked by me” records your assessment; inspect the page in the editor too."
"Translate images or a chapter first. Then review originals, translations and per-block hints here. Story setup is available now."
"%1$d text blocks • %2$d with hints\n%3$d checked by you • %4$d not reviewed"
"No blocks match on this page. Change the filter or page; this is not proof of correct meaning."
"No automatic hint — meaning still needs review."
"Could not check the project. Check story settings and try again."
"Fix empty text or internal markers before marking this checked."
"Original name or short phrase (up to 80 characters)"
"Also apply this correction to identical WHOLE source blocks"
"Also use for future translations in this language pair"

"Only identical whole blocks can be updated now; other sentences, placement and styles stay untouched. Keep the glossary story-scoped; clear it for a new story. Export from the editor to regenerate images."
"These settings belong to this saved project. Existing text is not automatically retranslated. To use them on the next translation, select the option below."
"Check number / ratio order against the source"
"Your preferred name / term is missing or occurs fewer times"
"This text has no source; review unless it is an intentional manual caption"
"Low OCR confidence; compare the source text with the image"
